title: int:Trade
description: An energy trade between a buyer and a seller, from matching through delivery verification. Subclass of cim:MarketDocument. Mirrors the Rust EwdsTradeDto (camelCase wire form; RFC 3339 creation timestamp).

tradeId.description: Nonzero bytes16 trade ID. Imports accept UUID or hex; reads/events use lowercase 0x hex. IRI: int:tradeId.

bidId.description: FK to bid Order. IRI: int:bidId.

buyerId.description: Nonzero on-chain bytes16 hash of the buying facility, not its owner or wallet. IRI: int:buyerId.

residualBidId.description: Residual bid ID; null, empty or all-zero inputs mean absence and are returned as null.

offerId.description: FK to offer Order. IRI: int:offerId.

sellerId.description: Nonzero on-chain bytes16 hash of the selling facility, not its owner or wallet. IRI: int:sellerId.

residualOfferId.description: Residual offer ID; null, empty or all-zero inputs mean absence and are returned as null.

tradeStatus.description: Trade lifecycle status: matched when included in a block indexed by the listener (no confirmation depth), executed after verification without penalties, settled after financial settlement (not yet implemented), or terminal penalized after a delivery penalty. IRI: int:tradeStatus.

tradeQuantity.description: Traded energy quantity in kWh. IRI: int:tradeQuantity. Unit: kWh. Must be > 0.

tradePrice.description: Settled trade price in EUR/kWh. IRI: int:tradePrice. Unit: EUR/kWh.

timestamp.description: Trade creation timestamp, unchanged by status updates. IRI: int:tradedAt. RFC 3339. Lifecycle notifications carry the status-change time in the event envelope's occurredAt.
